todo.owned: Nothing to do: it reads the inbox.
todo.instagram: Meta app with Instagram Public Content Access approved (for hashtag search).
todo.facebook: Meta app with pages_read_user_content (for Page reviews).
todo.threads: Threads app with threads_keyword_search and threads_read_replies approved; workspaces connect a Threads account.
todo.youtube: Add a YouTube Data API key (Google Cloud project, 10,000 units/day).
todo.youtube_comments: Same YouTube key; set the units each workspace may spend per run below.
todo.google_business: Google Business Profile API access for the Google app.
todo.linkedin: LinkedIn app with Community Management API (r_organization_social); workspaces connect their page.
todo.news: Optional: a GNews or NewsAPI key (Google News RSS is used otherwise).
todo.web: Add a Brave Search API key (≈ $5 per 1,000 searches).
todo.x: Add an X API bearer token (pay per post read).
todo.reddit: Add a Reddit app's client id and secret (commercial agreement with Reddit).
todo.telegram: Nothing to do: public channel pages are read.
todo.app_store: Nothing to do: Apple's public reviews feed.
todo.google_play: Not connected yet: needs a Play Console service account per app.

terms.tiktok: Unofficial provider: TikTok's terms do not allow scraping. Offer it knowing the risk.
terms.reddit: Commercial use needs an agreement with Reddit.
